trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Output tensor is an undersized view with insufficient storage for the matmul result and is passed via out=.

root_cause.aten_layer: Implicit view resizing of undersized output view

bug_oracle.description: Kernel writes beyond valid output storage.
bug_oracle.signal: heap buffer overflow / memory corruption detection

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary output view shapes and storage sizes relative to the expected matmul result.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct float32 CPU output tensors as views with storage smaller than the intended result shape.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Pass undersized output views through out= parameters to trigger implicit view resizing.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.matmul with out= a view tensor having insufficient storage; repeat for other out= operations such as torch.add and torch.linalg.pinv.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Run under memory sanitizers or memory corruption detectors and compare against safe non-view references.
